name: Duotone / gradient map
one_line: Luminance mapped onto a ramp of chosen colours, so a whole image speaks in one palette
summary: An image is reduced to its brightness and re-coloured along a short ramp, shadows in one hue and highlights in another. It unifies mixed photography under a brand palette and reads as bold, graphic and deliberate. A print duotone of overprinted inks looks different from a simple ramp, so choose which is meant.

routes.one_line: Map luminance to a colour ramp on stills or frames from the command line

steps.does: Convert each still or frame to grey, then map it onto the chosen ink colours

limits: ImageMagick evidence covers drawing solid frames, not colour mapping
Evidence ran ImageMagick 6; version 7 syntax differs and is untested
Baked into frames, so the palette cannot change with t

routes.one_line: Sample a ramp by pixel luminance in a fragment shader, live over footage or a scene

steps.does: Compute luminance per pixel and look up the ramp colour, with ramp stops free to animate from t

limits: WebGL evidence is a software-rendered triangle read back, not a textured full-frame effect
Which luma weights and colour space apply is yours to declare and verify

routes.one_line: Grey and look-up the colours across a whole clip or sequence in a filtergraph

steps.does: Convert to grey and remap through a lookup or generated colour table over the video

limits: FFmpeg evidence is a PNG sequence muxed to MP4; no colour lookup is exercised
A lookup applied after encode cannot be targeted at single layers
